newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE VOW TO FIGHT LAMAISON BAN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE VOW TO FIGHT LAMAISON BAN.

text.p: European Cup winners Brive vowed on Tuesday to fight a 30-day suspension given to their star back Christophe Lamaison by the Five Nations' disciplinary committee.
"We're not going to take this lying down. We'll find a solution," Brive president Patrick Sebastien said before a planned meeting with the French Rugby Federation (FFR).
"The ball is in the court of the federation. They can decide to have the suspension purged another way. But if they oblige us to punish Lamaison then we'll look at something else."
Lamaison was suspended on Monday for a late, high tackle on opposite number Craig Chalmers when France clinched the grand slam with a victory over Scotland in Paris earlier this month.
The ban deprives Brive of Lamaison, hero of France's crucial 23-20 victory over England at Twickenham, for several games in the run-in to the French club championship.
Brive consider the ban tantamount to restraint of trade.
Sebastien said clubs should not have to suffer for what happens to their players when they are in national colours.
